$comment: EXP-1291/NEW-1: the FIRST prompt of every new session is composed on the SERVER (`sessions.brief`, read by the device at pickup), so all four clients and every start path (composer, Start on an issue, an action, a trigger firing, an agent spawn, a follow-up child) produce byte-identical input. composeBrief(input) (TS reference packages/domain-contract/src/session-brief.ts; the server calls it, no client mirror needed beyond reading this spec) replays `cases`: sections in this order, each '## <heading>' + a blank line + its body, joined by a blank line, empty sections omitted: Request (the person's text, trimmed; image embed lines kept; NEW-2: a prompt run's body plus what was typed is already the text) · Issues (one '- <identifier> <title>' per issue in link order) · Parent (a child only: templates `parent` with {title} = the parent's title, {depth}/{maxDepth} = its depth and contract sessionsSend.treeMaxDepth, {branch} = the parent's branch; without a branch the `parentNoBranch` template). Nothing at all = `empty`. The result is cut at sessionsSend.briefMaxBytes UTF-8 bytes at the last newline that fits, ending in a '…' line. S-3 (owner 2026-10-28): plan mode is GONE (a plan is an `exponential_show {plan}` card, no gate): no Plan section.
